slides.etiqueta: 4 habits feeding your visceral fat without you noticing

slides.texto:
Beers, drinks, wine “to unwind”.
Regular drinking promotes belly fat and wrecks your sleep. A double hit.

Soda, juice, syrupy coffees.
Calories that don't fill you up and go straight to your waist.

On 5–6 hours you eat more, move less and your glucose metabolism gets worse.
Sleep is part of your diet.

Car, office, couch.
One hour at the gym doesn't cancel out 10 hours of sitting. Get up every hour, even for 3 minutes.

You don't need to change everything tomorrow.
Pick one of the four and fix it this week. Next week, the next one.

Every week I share how to optimize your hormones after 30, without living in the gym.
Follow me so you don't miss the next one.
